reason: Preserve JSX property names, TypeScript variance/type-only exports, generic function type arguments and newline-separated type members. Member separators are checked against source tokens by the input adapter.

replacements.after:
type_parameter: $ => seq(
        optional('const'),
        optional(seq('in', optional('out'))),
        optional('out'),

type_arguments: $ => choice(
        seq('<', commaSep1($.type), optional(','), '>'),
        seq(
          alias($._nested_function_type_argument, $.function_type),
          repeat(seq(',', $.type)), optional(','), '>',
        ),
      ),

      _nested_function_type_argument: $ => prec.left(seq(
        field('type_parameters', alias($._nested_type_parameters, $.type_parameters)),
        field('parameters', $.formal_parameters),
        '=>',
        field('return_type', choice($.type, $.asserts, $.type_predicate)),
      )),

      _nested_type_parameters: $ => seq(
        '<<', commaSep1($.type_parameter), optional(','), '>',
      ),

call_signature: $ => choice(
        $._call_signature,
        seq(
          field('type_parameters', optional($.type_parameters)),
          field('parameters', $.formal_parameters),
          field('return_type', alias($._closed_signature_return, $.type_annotation)),
          repeat(alias($._closed_generic_signature, $.call_signature)),
          alias($._following_generic_signature, $.call_signature),
        ),
      ),

      _closed_signature_return: $ => seq(':', choice(
        $.lookup_type, $.generic_type, $.predefined_type, $.array_type,
        $.tuple_type, $.object_type, $.literal_type, $.intersection_type, $.union_type,
      )),
      _closed_generic_signature: $ => seq(
        field('type_parameters', $.type_parameters),
        field('parameters', $.formal_parameters),
        field('return_type', alias($._closed_signature_return, $.type_annotation)),
      ),
      _following_generic_signature: $ => seq(
        field('type_parameters', $.type_parameters),
        field('parameters', $.formal_parameters),
        field('return_type', optional(choice($.type_annotation, $.asserts_annotation, $.type_predicate_annotation))),
      ),
